title: The Disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa
hook: Who took the powerful labor leader from a mysterious Detroit garage?
headline: Hoffa's baffling last day

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Jimmy Hoffa vanished from the Machus Red Fox restaurant in Bloomfield Township on July 30, 1975.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Witnesses reported a maroon Lincoln or Mercury car at 2:00 p.m.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Investigators found a blood-stained glove near the garage's back door.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2020 a former mob associate claimed Hoffa was buried under a Detroit landfill.

end.line: What really happened to Hoffa that night?

description: A quick look at the baffling disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa.

facts.claim: Jimmy Hoffa disappeared on July 30, 1975 from a Detroit restaurant.
A black Chevrolet Impala was reported near the garage around 2 a.m.
A blood-stained glove was found near the garage's back door.
In 2020 a former mob associate alleged Hoffa's body was buried under a Detroit landfill.
The case remains unsolved after extensive FBI investigation.
